_purpose: Live test fixture for the essence→scorer co-lever wire (E2E finding #6). Stages a Deep Glow that is weak IN THE WRONG DIMENSION: Exposure is already reasonable (1.6) but Radius is choked to 60 and Threshold gates out all but the brightest pixels — so a 'wide soft bloom wash' intent is UNREACHABLE by pushing the seeded lever (Exposure), which can only blow the small disc to white. Convergence therefore requires pivoting to a lever that appears NOWHERE in the seed plan, which is exactly what the essence-card injection makes possible. Before the wire, the scorer was told 'only reference matchNames visible in the plan' and could only ever say 'more Exposure'.
intent: 暗场中的明亮圆形光源，用于测试 Deep Glow 的辉光扩散半径

params: Radius — a small, bright point source
